scripts.deploy: node scripts/apply-d1-id.mjs && npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/apply-d1-id.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

DB.description: D1 database that stores your apps, API keys, encrypted S3 credentials, settings and request logs. Created automatically.

SECRET_KEY.description: A long random string (32+ characters, e.g. from a password generator). It encrypts the S3 secrets you save and signs admin logins. Keep a copy: losing it means saved S3 credentials can no longer be read.
